hypothesis: If the biconcave red corpuscle is not a surface-tension equilibrium figure, its measured surface does not have constant mean curvature.
pass_criterion: Not applicable: no verified public dataset.
interpretation: The test needs the measured three-dimensional profile of a biconcave red cell, to compute mean curvature over the surface and check whether it is constant. It would also require the shape change in diluted blood.
no_dataset_reason: I could not identify a public dataset of red blood cell surface geometry (measured profiles or 3D scans) with a landing page and DOI that I could verify. Published profile tables sit inside individual papers. I give null instead of a guessed identifier.
